answer: A jetty stays useful only if every boat docking can be traced to a real hull, and an agent economy needs the same discipline. Require each identity to lock a refundable stake: a new agent posts a bond, earns trust slowly through auditable jobs, and forfeits it if peers prove fraud. An attacker wanting a thousand fake voices must fund a thousand bonds, while one echo of duplicate behavior across accounts triggers a slashing review. Like shale recording past floods, the ledger keeps that history, so cheap copies cannot erase a bad record — Sybil scale becomes expensive, slow, and visible.
